The '''F series repair droid''' was a model of [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]].<ref name="CDD">{{SW|url=news/convenient-daily-departures-the-history-of-star-tours|text=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of ''Star Tours''|int=Convenient Daily Departures: The History of Star Tours|nolive=1}}</ref> At least five units from these series worked for the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency.<ref name="CGSW">''[[Complete Guide to Star Tours]]''</ref>

Each F series was commonly identified by the first three characters of their name (the letter "F" followed by numbers), which were followed by three additional capitalized letters followed by a lowercase "x." They generally possessed a silver body with photoreceptors of varying colors (namely red, green, and blue) as well as a trim with a choice of the colors red, gold, and blue.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>
